body:
### Summary

npm **12.2.1** and **11.21.1** bundle `undici@6.29.0` at `node_modules/npm/node_modules/undici`. It is a dependency of `node-gyp`, which requires `^6.25.0`. That version is affected by **CVE-2026-109383** / [GHSA-2m5v-pch6-74hx](https://github.com/nodejs/undici/security/advisories/GHSA-2m5v-pch6-74hx): `Agent` drops function-valued `tls` options such as `checkServerIdentity`. The fix is in **undici 6.29.1**, published 2026-10-15.

This is a different CVE from the ones fixed in #10088 / #10089 (bundled `undici` → 6.29.0), not a duplicate of #10062 / #10111. 6.29.0 is still inside the affected range (`>=4.0.0 <6.29.1`).

| Line | Branch | Bundled undici | Fixed in |
|---|---|---|---|
| npm 12 | `latest` (12.2.1) | 6.29.0 | 6.29.1 |
| npm 11 | `release/v11` (11.21.1) | 6.29.0 | 6.29.1 |

### Impact

Container image scanners (e.g. Cortex/Prisma, Trivy) flag the bundled `undici/package.json` as a CRITICAL finding (CVSS 9.1). Images that ship npm fail security gates even when Node's own bundled undici is patched. Node 22.23.4 / 24.22.1 / 26.12.1 already ship fixed runtime copies.

### Request

Please bump bundled `undici` to 6.29.1 on `latest`, and backport it to `release/v11`. The open release PR #10156 for 12.2.2 does not include it yet.

### Reproduce

```bash
npm pack npm@12.2.1 && tar -xOzf npm-12.2.1.tgz package/node_modules/undici/package.json | grep '"version"'
# "version": "6.29.0"
```
title: Bundled undici@6.29.0 is vulnerable to CVE-2026-109383 (fixed in 6.29.1)
